{{Quote|I'm honored to meet so many distinguished guests. I offer you welcome.|Queen Apailana, to Ferus Olin and his allies|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>}}
'''Apailana''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the successor to [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In a similar fashion to the previous [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]], she was formally styled '''Her Royal Highness, Queen Apailana of Naboo''' during her two-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] reign.

Apailana was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after it was revealed that she was harboring [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitives of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] on Naboo.

==Biography==
===Early life ([[32 BBY/Legends|32]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]])===
{{Quote|Our history with the Jedi has led me to trust what they say. I never believed the official story of Senator Amidala's death. I have encouraged Captain Typho to keep searching for answers, even though it seems there are none to be had. Near the end of her life, the Senator still had faith in the Jedi. We were in constant contact, so I am sure of this. I still think of the Jedi as friends&mdash;no matter if there is one or one thousand.|Queen Apailana, to Ferus Olin|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo" />}}
Apailana was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was one of the youngest [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]] ever elected on the peaceful world, succeeding [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] at the young age of twelve,<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> following the latter's two-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] term.<ref name="Card-Topps-Queen Apailana Queen of Naboo">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Queen Apailana (Queen of Naboo)}}</ref> She greatly revered [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], and aspired to be as good a ruler as her predecessors.<ref name="DB" /> Amidala, now a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], supported Apailana's bid for the [[Throne/Legends|throne]].<ref name="SWCE" />

[[File:Bibblemourning.png|thumb|right|200px|Apailana and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]], at the funeral of Senator Padmé Amidala]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the thirteen-year-old Queen was one of the chief mourners at Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]],<ref name="ROTS" /> wearing a [[Chersilk/Legends|chersilk]] mourning [[Robe/Legends|robe]] and a [[Shiraya fan headdress/Legends|Shiraya fan headdress]] in tribute to Amidala.<ref name="SWCE" /> The headdress was last worn by Jamillia.<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], Apailana made outward pretenses of loyalty, but secretly harbored doubts about the new regime. Throughout her reign, government buildings and organizations on Naboo continued to refer to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], not the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="DB" />

At some point, Apailana accompanied Senator [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] on a state visit to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planet of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]].<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> Naboo was colonized around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]] by an expedition sponsored by the then Queen of Grizmallt, [[Elsinoré den Tasia]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Although respectful of Naboo tradition in not ordering an investigation into Amidala's death, she privately disagreed with the official word from the Empire, which stated that Amidala had been killed at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Apailana then made it known to her inner council that should any Jedi who survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] be found on Naboo, they would be welcome to remain there.<ref name="DB" /> One such Jedi, [[Ferus Olin]], convinced her to shut down Naboo's comm systems and team with [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] in an [[Uprising in Theed|attack]] on the Imperial headquarters on Naboo.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo" />

===Assassination ([[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]])===
{{Quote|During the rise of the Empire, the Emperor's home planet of Naboo rapidly established itself as a major irritant. After a number of Naboo's ambassadors were sent home in various states of dismemberment, her newly-elected Queen broke off diplomatic ties and began exploring military options. Clearly it was time for a regime change, a change that would be effected by the 501st, now under the direct command of Darth Vader.|Unidentified 501st stormtrooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
[[File:Apailana_12_BBY.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Queen Apailana, during the Battle of Naboo in 18 BBY]]
This attack would prove Apailana's undoing, for [[18 BBY/Legends|soon after]], rumors began to circulate that she was indeed harboring Jedi fugitives. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], acting on this information, sent the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to Naboo with orders to kill the Queen and bring the planet back in line. The 501st uncovered her, but her prepared [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|security guards]] were able to put up a substantial fight against the 501st [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. With support from an [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturret]] grid, the small skirmish was prolonged and turned into a full-scale [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|battle]].<ref name="BFII" />

Shortly after the destruction of the autoturret grid's console and the death of many Naboo guards, Apailana appeared, armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]]. Also escaping with the Queen was a group of runaway Jedi who were acting as Apailana's personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. Their attack was also meant to cover the Queen's escape as she fled the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="BFII" />

[[File:Snipermakeshistargetr.jpg|thumb|200px|Queen Apailana, just before her death at the hands of Imperial snipers]]
However, the 501st proved too powerful for the Queen's Jedi protectors. A [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] quickly shot the Queen with his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] right outside the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]]. To add to the tragedy, none of the Jedi she was hiding survived, some dying protecting the Queen during the battle, and the rest being hunted and gunned down by Imperials after her death.<ref name="BFII" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|With the Queen eliminated, Naboo quickly fell in line. It was the first time the 501st was called upon to 'adjust' a planet's government, but it wouldn't be the last.|Unidentified 501st stormtrooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
Shortly thereafter,<ref name="SWCE" /> [[Kylantha]], who appeared&mdash;at least on the surface&mdash;more accepting of the Empire's control, was elected Queen of Naboo, a position she still held during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It feels kind of strange knowing that I rule the whole planet of Naboo and I'm only thirteen. At first, my face&mdash;because it was really white&mdash;was a bit of a shock. But when the whole costume was put together and the headdress was put on, I really felt proud, like a Queen.|Keisha Castle-Hughes|<ref name="Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
Apailana first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], released on [[May 19]], [[2005]]. She was portrayed by [[Keisha Castle-Hughes]].<ref name="ROTS" />
